description: LightGroup surface not shown in an alternate power/display context. The resident-card light group visibility is gated by sta_residentCardShow, which is CARD_LIGHTGROUP(2) only when val_residentCard==CARD_LIGHTGROUP; val_residentCard is hard-coded to 1 (CARD_CURRENTTIME) under the ALWASYS_SHOW_UI else-branch at diAEControl.cpp L122 and never assigned any other value. sta_residentCardShow therefore can never equal CARD_LIGHTGROUP and the LightGroup Draw/SetData body early-returns without a texture, so the surface is undrivable to a true SHOW through the harness. This case varies the power/drive context while the light-group show gate stays unreachable and asserts the negative label.

mem.desc: alternate power context exercised; cannot drive the resident-card light group
